mechanism: Irbesartan blocks angiotensin II receptor signaling, reducing aldosterone secretion and decreasing urinary potassium excretion, leading to hyperkalemia risk especially in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly, assess renal function, limit potassium supplementation, and counsel on dietary potassium restriction; contraindicate concurrent use in patients with baseline hyperkalemia or severe renal disease.
